senses.gloss: m. (= <cite ref="P01423"><he>עַרְעַי</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="P01411"><he>עֲרַע</he></cite> a. <cite ref="A03216"><he>אֲרַע</he></cite>)

evil, misfortune. Sifra B’ḥuck., Par. 2, ch. V (ref. to קרי, Lev. XXVI, 23, sq.) אתם עשיתם … עריי בעולם אף אני … ע׳ וכ׳ you made my laws of justice a misfortune in the world, so I shall make you a misfortune in the world; ib. ch. VIII; Yalk. Lev. 675 עראי.

units: <cite ref="Sukkah 2a:14">Succ. 2ᵃ</cite> <he>צא מדירת קבע ושב בדירת ע׳</he> leave the permanent, and live in a temporary dwelling.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 2:9">Ib. II, 9</cite> <he>כל</he> … <he>סוכתו קבע ודירתו ע׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>וביתו</he>) during the seven days (of the Feast of Booths) man must make his booth the permanent and his dwelling the incidental residence.
<cite ref="Sukkah 26a:15">Ib. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>אכילת ע׳</he> an incidental meal, luncheon, opp. to <he>אכילת קבע</he> a regular meal.

<cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 1:5">Maasr. I, 5</cite> <he>אוכל מהם ע׳ וכ׳</he> (sub <he>אכילת</he>) he may make of them an irregular meal until &c.; <cite ref="Tosefta Ma'asrot 1:11">Tosef. ib. I, 11</cite>, a. e. <cite ref="A03223"><he>אַרְעַי</he></cite> ed. Wil., oth. <cite ref="P01241"><he>עראי</he></cite>. Succ. l. c. <he>שינת ע׳</he> irregular sleep, a nap; a. fr.
